text:
SumatoSoft is a software development company that focuses on helping businesses to reach their goals and needs, assigns experienced software development teams with the main focus in RoR, React.js and Node.js technologies, guarantees transparent workflows and communication, and uses the best industry practices ensuring continuous value delivery.
 ‍Having developed more than 150 custom solutions in IoT, Healthcare, FinTech and other industries for more than 100 companies from 25+ countries, including the USA since 2012.
 ﻿***You will work in a small team (not more than 2-3 QA engineers). Also, on some other projects you are expected to work as a single QA. You will be in charge of WEB projects with the next tech stack: Ruby+ React, NodeJS+React.
 Challenges and goals you'll own:

• Plan and run all needed manual functional testing, cross-browser/cross-platforms (mobile devices), acceptance testing. Plan and execute regression testing with reasonable coverage.

• Test strategy preparation and execution (for different phases of the Project) according project goals and resources (with QA Lead helping).

• Create optimal Test Documentation: Test Plans, check-list/test cases, other types of test Documents (tables, MindMaps, Schemas and etc.)

• Make requirements analysis and clarification blank spots.

• Communicate with Business Analyst, developers, Product owners and other team members.

• Estimate required testing activities.

• Perform ﻿work progress providing for team members on sprint meeting and by request.

• Work under 2 projects in parallel.

 What we expect from you:

• At least 10 months of QA expertise

• Full understanding of manual QA processes and methods for different project phases. 

• Updating test strategy according to project stages. 

• Willing to release product with good quality.

• Proficiency in test-design techniques and creation of test documentation: Partition classes, Boundary Testing, State&Transition techniques, Decision Tables.

• Ability to write SQL requests (select, select with joins).

• Experience in BTS/TTS or similar systems (Jira, Zephyr Scale / TestRail).

• Experienced Chrome Developer Tools users.

• Basic knowledge of API testing.

• Web-technologies knowledge (understanding main concepts of client-server architecture, API, xml, css, html, http).

• Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile: Scrum/Kanban).

 Nice to have:

• Experience in Mobile testing process and testing tools (iTools, Android studio, xCode).

• Some experience in Automation/Performance/Security testing.

 What we can offer:

• Career and professional growth.

• English lessons.

• Company events, gifts for holidays.

• Ability to work from anywhere in the world.

 If you find it interesting feel free to apply, and we will contact you to discuss the position in detail. 
 We will be happy to see YOU as part of our team!
